name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Reverse-Grip Row
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a 30-to-45-degree incline and lie chest-down on the pad with your feet braced firmly on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand palm-forward grip so your arm hangs straight down toward the floor.
Drive your elbow back along your side, pulling the dumbbell toward your hip while squeezing your shoulder blade back.
Lower the weight slowly back to a full arm extension, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the bench instead of rotating or lifting your torso to yank the weight.
Lead the pull with your elbow and keep your shoulder down away from your ear.
